# ADR-NNNN: Title

- Status: proposed | accepted | superseded | rejected
- Date: YYYY-MM-DD

## Context

What problem and constraints require a durable decision?

## Decision

What is being chosen?

## Consequences

What becomes easier, harder, required, or risky?

## Alternatives

What credible options were considered and why were they not chosen?

## Rollback or supersession

How can this decision be reversed or replaced?
